svg.title: Tracking a moving target with a Kalman filter
svg.desc: Animation of a target lapping an oval route among four anchors given by latitude and longitude. Every 500 ms its distances to the anchors are measured with 3.0 m of noise and solved for a single fix; a constant-velocity Kalman filter smooths the fixes into a track. Root-mean-square error: 3.12 m for single fixes, 1.77 m for the filter. Last filtered position 40.01446° N, 105.26920° W.
svg.text: RMS error: single fixes 3.1 m, Kalman filter 1.8 m
